pages.title: The Turf
pages.text: Sky down to about sixty. Fields, herds, weather. Ore is up here too - the surface was seeded on purpose, so going deeper is a choice rather than a requirement.

pages.title: The Old Diggings
pages.text:
Sixty down to nothing. Ordinary work by ordinary people. Coal, copper, iron, tin.

This is the richest band for BULK. If you want volume, dig here. Nothing here is a secret.

pages.title: The Deep Works
pages.text:
Nothing down to minus sixty-four. Corners become square. Shafts run the wrong way for ore, sized for something that was not a person, or was a person shaped wrong.

The watching starts here. Everyone notices; nobody agrees on when.

pages.title: The Sealed Floor
pages.text:
Minus sixty-four to the bottom at minus one hundred and twenty-eight, and the last eight blocks are the worst of it. Reinforced - not sturdy, reinforced - by people who expected to be attacked.

Diamond, redstone, gold and lapis are densest here. So is the black residue. So are the Vaults.
